name: Wallcast
author: Echo Opera
description: Ten image shaders for on-air graphics, cyber-city screens and EDM video walls. Attach a still or clip to a layer and treat it; a night-skyline test image plays when nothing is attached.

styles.name: Prism Split
styles.blurb: Radial colour split and anamorphic light streaks that flare on every kick.

inputs.label: Source
inputs.hint: Still or clip to treat. Without one, the kit's test image plays.

params.label: Spectral fringe
params.hint: Adds a seven-tap rainbow fringe on top of the RGB split.

params.label: Cool streak
params.hint: Cyan streak mixed in opposite the amber one.

params.label: Beats / loop
params.hint: Kick pulses per loop. The limiter caps this at 3 per second.

params.label: Beat drive
params.hint: How hard the internal beat drives the effect.

params.label: Hit
params.hint: Map a live kick band here to drive the effect from audio.

params.label: HUD frame
params.hint: Corner brackets, numeric readout and a beat trace.

params.label: Readout
params.hint: Shown as four digits. Key it or map a data channel to it.

styles.name: Halftone Pulse

params.label: Registration

params.label: Source under-print

styles.name: Depth Stack
styles.blurb: Background, mid and foreground at three depths. The foreground keeps its alpha and casts a shadow.

inputs.label: Background
inputs.hint: Backdrop photo or clip. It also feeds the mid layer.

inputs.label: Foreground
inputs.hint: Cut-out or product shot. Transparent PNGs keep their alpha.

params.label: Camera Y

params.label: Orbit
params.hint: Loops one slow circle per loop.

params.label: Mid layer
params.hint: Screen-blends a deeper copy of the background.

params.label: Key out dark
